thought.text: `bin/setup` completed successfully and generated an admin account (`admin@example.org` / `TTOF3UHA0bsQ`). Now let me start the development server via `bin/dev`.

reasoning_content:
`bin/setup --skip-server` completed successfully (exit 0). An admin user was automatically generated: `admin@example.org`, password `TTOF3UHA0bsQ`.

Next, let's start the development server. The guide says to open http://localhost:3000. `bin/dev` runs `foreman start -f Procfile.dev`, and this launches both `bin/rails s` and `bin/vite dev`. Let's try running it in the background.

Note: bin/dev will install foreman if it isn't installed. Let's make sure foreman is available — it'll be installed via gem install. Let's run it.

action.command:
export PATH="/opt/tools/ruby-3.4.10/bin:/opt/tools/node-v24.9.0/bin:$PATH"
cd /workspace
export APP_DB_HOST=localhost APP_DB_USERNAME=samarbeid APP_DB_PASSWORD=samarbeid APP_DB_DATABASE=samarbeid_development
gem list foreman -i --silent || gem install foreman 2>&1 | tail -1
mkdir -p /tmp/dev
nohup bin/dev > /tmp/dev/server.log 2>&1 &
echo "dev server started, pid $!"
